$comment: Seed catalog for `npm run seed`. Entries carry identity and notes, and may optionally carry a creativeDirection so an authored design is reproducible. Bottle images and bottle analysis are always produced inside the app, so nothing about the product reference is hardcoded. Seeded notes land UNAPPROVED so a human signs them off before they drive a campaign.

perfumes.name: Black Diamond Incense
perfumes.$notesComment: Sourced from the brand's own store page (saudi.ibraqperfumes.com) and cross-confirmed on Fragrantica. Launched 2023, unisex.

creativeDirection.environment: a dark polished stone gallery with a single high slit window
creativeDirection.background: warm graphite stone falling into deep shadow, with diamond-shaped light patterns thrown across it
creativeDirection.surface: honed dark grey stone with a faint cold sheen, as though just wiped
creativeDirection.lighting: one hard cold slit of light from the upper left that refracts through the faceted glass and throws diamond patterns across the stone, with a low warm ember glow catching the gold
secondaryElements: a single bead of water on stone
creativeDirection.composition: bottle centred and upright on the stone, its facets catching the slit light and casting diamond patterns to the right, ingredients low and to the sides, smoke rising behind, wide dark negative space above for typography
creativeDirection.cameraAngle: straight-on editorial angle at label height
creativeDirection.visualStory: Cold light cutting through faceted glass while oud smoulders at its base

perfumes.$bottleComment: Reference sourced from the web via the Find-the-bottle flow. Smoky grey pressed glass with a diamond-lozenge facet pattern, polished gold sphere cap, champagne-gold label plate.
